name: slop-check
description: Check any draft, document, pull request, chart or spec for the habits that mean nobody edited or reviewed it before it shipped, and name the specific lines.

interface.shortDescription: Catch the habits that mean nobody edited it
interface.longDescription: The question worth asking about a piece of work is not whether a machine touched it, it is whether a person with judgement went through it afterwards. This checks for the habits that say nobody did: filler and machine vocabulary in prose, placeholders and swallowed errors in code, numbers too round to be measured in a chart, and options laid out with no recommendation in a spec. It names the specific lines, so a finding is something to act on or to send back. In Claude Code it also installs a hook that blocks em dashes and choppy sentence runs in the assistant's own writing; Codex plugins cannot register hooks, so there it runs on request.
defaultPrompt: Slop-check this before I post it.
Did anyone actually review this doc?
How much of this pull request looks unreviewed?
Check this spec for options with no recommendation.
